subject: Linkage section (whether access to linkage section items is meaningful when called from a non-COBOL program)
notes: (kb/Work PB2671, wave 1040 group S.) cite.py --check A.1 "Linkage section (whether access to linkage section items is meaningful when called from a non-COBOL program)" -> OK §A.1 116); --check 13.7.4 "If a program is activated by a non-COBOL runtime element, the implementor defines whether access to formal parameters and the returning item is guaranteed" -> OK 3); --check 13.7.4 "If the runtime element containing the linkage section is activated by a non-COBOL runtime element, the initial value of a linkage section data item is defined by the implementor" -> OK 5). The determination (CONFORMANCE.md §7) names the one non-COBOL activator, a .NET host, and states both entries. The witness is a real C# host compiled with Roslyn: ProgramRegistry.CallProgram (ICobolProgram.Call) binds the host's carriers positionally (the program's stores reach the host, RETURNING is delivered), a ManagedPointer.Null carrier and a shorter argument list each make the formal OMITTED; ProgramRegistry.RunMain (ICobolProgram.Activate) on a fresh instance shows every formal at its category default with no linkage VALUE applied (alphanumeric spaces, display and binary numerics zero, pointer NULL, a group formal its leaves' defaults), and after a call on the same instance each formal keeps that call's binding. Writing the test found the determination broken twice on the Activate arm: a group (AREA) formal had no storage, so its first reference was the fatal EC-DATA-PTR-NULL, and an image-stored binary or packed formal was seeded with spaces, a nonzero invalid value. Both are fixed at the unbound seed (DataEmitter.UnboundFormalImage; CobolArgAdapt.Unbound for an AREA formal at the main entry). REFUTER ROUND (2026-10-08 05:05): the first fix chose the unbound image by IsElementary, so an ADDRESS OF-referenced PIC N(2) formal (an AREA) got a 2-character carrier image in a 4-position record cell and died with EC-BOUND-PTR at the main entry; and an OMITTED area national formal under a COBOL CALL read its space-filled cell as byte pairs (NOT SPACES). Root fix: the shape follows the STORAGE (DataEmitter.UnboundFormalRecord for every record-shaped cell, UnboundFormalCarrier for a carrier); every area formal takes that category-default cell whenever it is not laid over an argument (DataEmitter.AreaFormalShape, program and method ABIs alike); an omitted carrier reads the same value (CobolArgAdapt.Text and TextValue take the unbound factory). The host test now carries an addressed national LK and a floating-point LF, and 2002/pb2671_omitted_formal_category_default pins every category, usage and storage omitted under a COBOL CALL. Refuter round 2 (wording): the determination no longer compares the unbound value with a VALUE-less WORKING-STORAGE item, which an OPTIONS paragraph INITIALIZE WORKING-STORAGE clause would change; it states the category default itself. retired-witness: conformance-test:NonCobolActivatorLinkageTests.ANetHost_CallGuaranteesLinkageAccess_MainEntrySeesCategoryDefaultsOrTheLastCallsBinding (kb/Work PB2099 retired the untyped host route (ProgramRegistry.CallProgram/RunMain); the same witness, renamed, now hosts the generated entry, and DOC-A.1-116 states the entry's determination)
